title: lennrt/palomar-formalizations
summary: A concrete formalization of the infinite-family construction in the source: cycle and Cartesian-product distances on P_m □ C_(6m), the displayed landmarks (0,0), (0,2m), and (m-1,0), the four-piece cycle distance-pair locus, and injectivity of the resulting unordered multiset code for every even m at least 2. This establishes the three-landmark resolving upper bound. It does not formalize the separate general lower bound needed to conclude that the set is a basis or that the multiset dimension equals 3.

formalizes.title: Multiset Dimension of Cylindrical Graphs: An Infinite Family and a Certified Census

review.reason: Lean formalization of a three-landmark resolving upper bound for a Cartesian-product graph family.
